title: Amma gawah rehna
body:
Haaayee hussain bewatan (2) khanjar tale hu pyaasa,  bhai raha na beta ,ay waarise rukaiya nana se jaake kehna , maine nibhaya waadaa
Ammaa…..haaaye
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (6)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khanjar tale bhi dekho sajde me sar hai mera
Nau laakh  qaatilo ne tanha samaj ke ghera
Wada nibha raha hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Che roz ho gaye hai mujhe paani na mila
Akbar ki naujawaani ,asgar ki bezubaani
Sehra me kho chukka hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tiro ne chhaan daalaa , amma mere badan ko
Kitna garib hu ab mohtaaj hu kafan ko
Halat baadshaah hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalti hui zaameen par tiro ka hai bichona
Is haal me na dekhe mujhko meri sakina
Tiro pe so raha hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch der pehle amma asgar ko dafn karke
Bano ko jab khabar di , ankho me ashk bharke
Khud laash ban gaya hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sine se naujawan ke kaise nikaale barchi
Barchi ke saath amma , meri bhi saas tuti
Binaai dhundta hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap aye hai sunaane , naade ali sunaane
Mujhko talab kiya hai , amma mere khuda ne
Jaake me jaa raha hu
<<MINI>>
Amma gawah rehna (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehan aur raza ki jo naukri hai amma
Zakhmo ka tere marham nauha jari hai amma
Mai unko chahta hu
